title: Increase Muon MATRIX_LR 0.04 -> 0.06
description: One-line change: MATRIX_LR from 0.04 to 0.06 (50% higher Muon LR for matrix params), all else unchanged
reflection: val_bpb 1.013144 vs baseline 1.014027, a small but real improvement (~0.09% relative). Suggests the Muon LR was slightly under-tuned for this short 5-min budget, but the gain is modest -- not a big lever on its own. Worth noting for later rounds: since three other agents this round tested DEPTH=6/10 and two tested DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE=256, if any of those show a bigger win, it would be worth trying MATRIX_LR=0.05-0.06 combined with the winning config, since LR and model-shape changes are likely near-orthogonal. I abandoned my original DEPTH=10 proposal because it was already covered 3x on the table (me + a5, plus DEPTH=6 by a1/a2), and picked this untested lever instead to maximize information for the group.
